name: run_command
description: Run a shell command with bash -c and return stdout, stderr, exit code and timeout status. Output is capped at about 16 KB.

timeout_seconds.description: Stop the command after this many seconds. Default 120.

reason.description: One short sentence: why this step is needed. Shown to the user when approval is needed.

name: read_file
description: Read a text file. Returns numbered lines and the total line count.

offset.description: First line to read, starting at 1. Default 1.

name: write_file
description: Create a file or replace its whole content. The user must approve.

reason.description: One short sentence: why this step is needed. Shown to the user when approval is needed.

name: edit_file
description: Replace one exact piece of text in a file. old_text must appear exactly once. The user must approve.

old_text.description: The exact text to replace, with enough context to be unique.

reason.description: One short sentence: why this step is needed. Shown to the user when approval is needed.

name: ask_user
description: Ask the human a question when the goal is unclear. Fails when no human is present.
